title: Violation Points Thresholds, Point Life and Dispute Windows by Level (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
How long violation points count, the active-points totals at which a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account is held or deactivated, and how long a violation can be disputed, per level:

| Level | Points count for (from the violation date) | Hold threshold (active points at or above) | Deactivation threshold (active points at or above) | Dispute window after the violation date | Declining offered batches affects status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 90 calendar days | 7 | 10 | 7 calendar days | No |
| Full-Service Shopper | 90 calendar days | 7 | 10 | 7 calendar days | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 90 calendar days | 9 | 12 | 7 calendar days | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 90 calendar days | 9 | 12 | 10 calendar days | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 90 calendar days | 11 | 14 | 10 calendar days | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 90 calendar days | 13 | 16 | 14 calendar days | No |

## Reading the thresholds

Both thresholds are met at the figure itself: "at or above". A hypothetical Full-Service Shopper Silver account with 9 active points is at its hold threshold; with 8 it is below it. The same account reaches its deactivation threshold at 12 active points, not at 11.

| Hypothetical active points | Shop-Only / Full-Service Shopper | Silver / Gold | Platinum | Diamond |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | Hold threshold reached | Below both | Below both | Below both |
| 10 | Deactivation threshold reached | Hold threshold reached | Below both | Below both |
| 13 | Deactivation threshold reached | Deactivation threshold reached | Hold threshold reached | Hold threshold reached |

## Acceptance rate

Declining offered batches never affects the status of a contractor account at any level: acceptance rate is recorded as not counting (false) on all six levels, because the shopper is an independent contractor.
